## About Me

Neena Varanasi is a junior majoring in Statistics and Data Science at the University of Texas at Austin. She is a member of the Polymathic Honors Program and is pursuing certificates in Programming and Computation, Advanced Mathematics, and Evidence and Inquiry. Neena’s academic interests include bioinformatics and machine learning, where she enjoys exploring how data-driven methods can advance scientific discovery. Outside of school, she loves listening to music, trying new restaurants, and traveling.
